name: Missionaries All Christians Should Be As
overview: Scripture reveals that all believers are called to participate actively in God's service, exemplified by the willing and abundant offerings of the Israelites for the sanctuary's work, as recorded in Exodus 35 and 36. This readiness reflects a heart committed to the Lord's purposes, echoing the identity of God's people as a kingdom of priests and a holy nation in Exodus 19. The Passover instructions in Exodus 12 emphasize the importance of instructing future generations about God's deliverance, underscoring the missionary responsibility inherent in every Christian's life to proclaim and embody God's saving work.
